description: This file defines a Drupal Views field plugin class 'NodeNewComments' that displays the number of new comments on nodes, including methods for querying, rendering, and linking to new comments.

classes.name: NodeNewComments
classes.description: A Drupal Views field plugin class for displaying the number of new comments on nodes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes database, entity type manager, and entity field manager services.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes additional fields for the view.

methods.name: buildOptionsForm
methods.description: Builds the options form for the plugin.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Prepares the database query for fetching comment counts.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares data before rendering, including fetching comment counts for nodes.

methods.name: renderLink
methods.description: Creates a link to the first new comment if enabled.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the field value, possibly as a link.
